t: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Co Company Profile - Overview - GlobalData
s: Scotts Miracle-Gro markets its products under the Roundup, Gro Pro, Scotts, Miracle-Gro, Titan, Ortho, Gavita, Earthgro, Hyponex, General Hydroponics, Turf Builder, Home Defense, and Tomcat brand names. It serves warehouse clubs, home centers, mass merchandisers, independent hardware stores, nurseries, large hardware chains, garden centers, food and drug stores, e-commerce platforms, indoor gardening, and hydroponic product distributors, growers, and retailers.
